seasonStyles.text: Storybook illustration for a children's detective mystery game: warm, inviting and gently mysterious, never scary. No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. Style: hand-drawn ink line drawing with soft watercolour washes on warm cream mulberry paper, lightly stylised rather than photographic; deep navy night tones with warm lantern-gold light, muted Joseon red and pine-green accents used sparingly; clear architectural perspective; full-bleed composition with no border. Setting: Hanyang, Joseon Korea, 1446 — Joseon-era clothing, wooden palace architecture, paper doors, low floor desks and floor cushions only; no modern objects, no Western furniture or decoration. When King Sejong appears he is a calm, warm, thoughtful man in his late forties with a neat dark beard, in a red royal robe with round gold dragon badges on the chest and shoulders and a black winged royal cap; never copied from any existing painted portrait.

assets.subject: s5_seoul.writing_room
assets.description: Sora's writing room (M3): its picture reused from the first pilot design.
assets.prompt: A palace copyists' room of Joseon Korea at night, seen from the doorway: a long low writing desk across the back of the room with ink stones and rolled paper; on the left, a low wooden work table with one small closed drawer in its front; in the lower left middle, an open wooden crate holding rolled paper; in the centre right, a small wooden chest with a closed lid standing on a woven straw rug; floor cushions, lattice paper doors, warm lamp light. The floor, the rug and the chest are clean: no ink drops, no loose hairs, no scraps of paper. The three hiding places stand well apart, each fully visible.
notes: M3's place (the note put back together on SyllableBoard): no traces are read on it any more.

assets.subject: sora
assets.description: Sora, a palace maid: M3's talk after the find.
assets.prompt: A young palace maid of Joseon Korea, about seventeen, in a simple palace maid's hanbok with a plain jacket and long skirt, hair braided and tied, holding a small folded practice paper in both hands, a kind and slightly nervous expression.
notes: M3's talk after its puzzle (her practice page).

assets.subject: s5_seoul.map
assets.description: The pilot's Mission Map: the palace grounds of Hanyang, 1446, its three places drawn apart.
assets.prompt: An illustrated bird's-eye map of a royal palace compound of Joseon Korea in 1446, seen from high above at a slight angle, north at the top, on warm cream mulberry paper: curved grey-tiled roofs, red-pillared wooden halls, stone-paved courtyards, low stone walls, pine trees and a small pond. Three places stand clearly apart: in the lower middle, the main wooden gatehouse with a wide stone courtyard in front of it; in the left upper middle, a long records hall with its own small walled yard; in the right upper middle, a smaller workshop hall with paper doors. Soft dusk light, gentle shadows. No names, no labels, no pins, no writing, no numbers anywhere; nothing modern.
notes: The pilot's SeasonMap (lib/data/season5/season5_content.dart): the gatehouse is the inner gate, the right hall the well yard and the writing room, the left hall the book hall.

assets.subject: s5_seoul.prologue
assets.description: The case's opening at night: the palace in Hanyang, 1446, one window still lit.
assets.prompt: A tall portrait view over a royal palace of Joseon Korea at night in autumn 1446: curved tiled roofs and red-pillared halls in the blue dark under a bright moon, pine trees, the mountains behind; one paper window in the upper middle of the picture glowing warm gold as if someone is still inside. Quiet and mysterious, never scary. Composition for a phone screen: the top eighth is quiet night sky; the glowing window between 15% and 55% of the height, within the central two-thirds of the width; the lower 40% is a calm, darker stone courtyard with no detail, where words will lie.
notes: The pilot's Story Intro backdrop (StoryIntroScreen, SeasonContent.introBackdrops).

assets.subject: sejong
assets.description: King Sejong: the final talk's face.
assets.prompt: King Sejong of Joseon, about forty-eight, a calm, warm and thoughtful man with a neat dark beard and kind, searching eyes, in a red royal robe with round gold dragon badges on the chest and shoulders and a black winged royal cap, holding one sheet of blank paper in both hands; seated three-quarter view. A dignified king of the fifteenth century, never copied from any existing painted portrait.
notes: The final interview's portrait (TalkScene). A real person: his look is the game's own, never a copy of a portrait.

assets.subject: taek
assets.description: Taek, the night guard: M1's and M3's talks.
assets.prompt: A palace night guard of Joseon Korea, about thirty, in a dark blue guard's coat with a wide black hat, holding an unlit paper lantern, an honest, slightly embarrassed expression.
notes: M1's and M3's talks before their puzzles.

assets.subject: bun_i
assets.description: Bun-i, the water-carrier: the ending's face.
assets.prompt: A water-carrier girl of Joseon Korea, about thirteen, in a plain undyed cotton hanbok with a white headcloth, a wooden water bucket at her side, a bright, shy and determined expression.

assets.subject: s5_seoul.inner_gate
assets.description: The inner gate at night (M1): its three places read, its traces drawn by the app.
assets.prompt: A palace inner gate of Joseon Korea at night, seen from inside the courtyard: in the centre, a closed wooden gate with a curved tiled roof, a blank wooden signboard above it and three wide stone steps in front of it; on the left, the dark open doorway of a scholars' hall with a raised wooden floor; on the right middle, a small wooden guard post with a glowing iron brazier beside it; at the far right edge, a narrow stone path leading away toward a kitchen well with clay water jars. The lower third of the picture is plain, damp stone paving with open space in front of the steps. Rain clouds gather in a navy sky.
notes: M1's traces (copiedScrap, waterRing, waterDrops) are drawn by the app over measured areas: nothing written is in the picture.

assets.subject: s5_seoul.well_yard
assets.description: The servants' well yard at night (M2).
assets.prompt: A palace servants' yard of Joseon Korea at night beside a round stone well with a wooden lid and a rope bucket, clay water jars along a low wall; on the wall of a low building hangs a small plain wooden lesson board, completely blank; a paper lantern on a post gives soft warm light. The lower part of the picture is plain packed earth.
notes: M2's place (the letter lock is the app's).

assets.subject: s5_seoul.book_hall
assets.description: The book hall in the rain (the final).
assets.prompt: A palace book hall of Joseon Korea at night in steady rain: a long wooden hall with a curved tiled roof, one small dark gap in the tiles, closed lattice doors with an iron lock, paper lanterns under the eaves reflecting on wet stone; a few palace servants hold up a large sheet of oiled paper beneath the eaves. Hopeful, never frightening. The hall sits in the upper 60% of the picture; the lower part is plain wet stone paving with open space.
notes: The final's place and talk background: its lower part stays plain for the talk.

assets.subject: s5_seoul.kings_study
assets.description: The Story Intro: King Sejong in his study at night, showing the new letters.
assets.prompt: A king's private study in a Joseon palace at night, seen from behind the king: King Sejong sits at a low lacquered desk with his back to the viewer, only his black winged royal cap and the shoulders of his red royal robe with a round gold dragon badge seen, his face not shown; before him a few sheets of blank cream paper, a brush resting on an ink stone, a folding screen painted with pines, lattice paper doors, two candle lamps. Composition for a phone screen: the top eighth is quiet dark wall; the king and his desk between 15% and 55% of the height, within the central two-thirds of the width; the lower 40% is a calm, darker floor with no detail, where words will lie. No writing on any paper.
notes: The pilot's Story Intro backdrop (SeasonContent.introBackdrops): the King meets the detective, seen from behind (no face to match the portrait; no reference picture, to stay within the $1.00 budget).
